climate_pressure: Flooding, drought and geological hazards in the source's regional climate-risk assessment.
documented_impact: Climate impacts threaten displaced households' safety and economic stability.
fcv_mediator: Protracted conflict-related displacement, inadequate housing and limited services and livelihood opportunities increase vulnerability.
possible_consequence: Displaced households may sustain greater hazard-related harm and livelihood disruption; no new violent conflict is inferred.
alternative_explanations: Poverty, building quality and hazard exposure also shape losses independently of displacement.
Regional synthesis is not a matched local comparison.
uncertainty: Source-stated vulnerability mechanism, not causal identification; do not assign uniform exposure to all IDPs or named conflict territories.
resilience_factors: Adequate housing, accessible basic services and livelihood support can reduce the stated vulnerability; effectiveness is not evaluated here.
compact_statement: Conflict-related displacement and inadequate housing/services can magnify climate-hazard vulnerability in Georgia; no climate-caused conflict claim.
